product: Cartesia — speech to text, realtime (Ink WebSocket)

source_audio.description: No audio was submitted and no request was issued: this frame is authored to Cartesia's published realtime speech-to-text protocol documentation, not captured from the service. The flush_done message carries no transcript, so no spoken or written content is involved at all.

redaction.notes: Nothing was redacted because nothing was captured. request_id holds the nil GUID — the placeholder form protocol section 4 prescribes for a correlating identifier — because no real request exists to identify.

terms.basis: docs/guides/provider-recording-protocol.md section 7 — no Output was captured at all; the fixture is authored to Cartesia's published protocol documentation. Cartesia's own verdict for a capture is permitted-with-conditions, and it is not what blocks one here (see notes)

source_schema.method: The documented field set of the realtime speech-to-text flush_done message was read from the page above: type, request_id and the documented-deprecated is_final. No vendor example payload, prose or field description was copied — only the documented field names and the literal message-type constant 'flush_done', which is interface, not expression. Every value is our own fiction.

notes: The non-transcript control frame, and the deprecated field on it is deliberate. CartesiaSpeechRecognizer deserializes EVERY text frame into its transcript DTO and only then filters on type != "transcript", so a control frame that also carries is_final true — as this documented-deprecated field does — is the case where a broken filter would leak an empty transcript through as a final result. Nothing in the suite could send that frame before this fixture existed. WHY THIS IS DOCUMENTATION-DERIVED RATHER THAN CAPTURED, and it is NOT a terms problem: section 7 of the protocol guide records Cartesia as permitted-with-conditions, so the terms would have permitted a real capture; the reason there is no capture is that NO CAPTURE CREDENTIAL EXISTS IN THIS ENVIRONMENT. A real capture is a known, cleared upgrade path here whenever a credential appears. What this artifact is worth, stated plainly: a documented schema is what the vendor says it sends, not what it sent on any given day, and this route cannot close the does-the-vendor-honour-its-own-docs half of the ADR-0041 D4 gap. The page publishes no revision marker, so a silent breaking edit there is indistinguishable from no edit at all.
